facts.fact: The education ministry launched a service on the Houwiyati platform to extract and confirm national certificates, available for certificates issued after 2013 or already linked to the holder's national number (NNI) by the ministry; the AMI report gives no figures. Dated by its published date.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Digital Transformation Ministry

MRT.note: The service links education certificates to the NNI; it does not state that people are checked against the ID by another system.
